assessment.why: Justin alone is specifically tied by his own admission to handling the actual cyanide original and the target glass. Final checkable explanations weaken Chip and Al. His wrong-prop claim is possible but leaves the strongest physical chain. This supports an accusation, not conclusive identification.

plausibility_notes: No released observation directly ties Justin to the forced theft, contaminated miniature, matched neck shard or pouring. Multiple handling is inferential, not proof of transfer. Stage8 offers corroboration for rivals but many are still self-reports.
